title: 14 October 2026 Artifact Wave
summary: Here is what we got as new Jetpack artifacts this week!
content:
We have a new artifact group, androidx.annotation.keep, containing some plugins and multiplatform libraries:

  • androidx.annotation.keep:androidx.annotation.keep.gradle.plugin:1.0.0-alpha01
